title: Generated this using only free open source softwares (not Gen1 or Gen2)
author: ptitrainvaloin

comments.author: ptitrainvaloin
comments.body:
I've managed to run Potat1 in txt2vid (Automatic1111 SD webui) in mid-res on an RTX 3060 12GB VRAM.

This is not GEN1 or GEN2, 100% made with free open source softwares.

If you have any question, feel free to ask

replies.author: real_onco
replies.body:
Hi, I'm new to this, so sorry for my ignorance. Reading other comments by you on other of your nice creations, I've seen that you need to install Potat1 replacing an old modelscope.  I'm working on Colab, as I have no powerful computer. Would you mind explaining what steps you need to do?  


Departing from this Automatic1111 notebook: [https://stable-diffusion-art.com/automatic1111-colab/](https://stable-diffusion-art.com/automatic1111-colab/)

\+ I've installed as a model: [https://huggingface.co/camenduru/potat1](https://huggingface.co/camenduru/potat1)

\+ As an extension: [https://github.com/kabachuha/sd-webui-text2video](https://github.com/kabachuha/sd-webui-text2video)

\+ As a model: [https://huggingface.co/DREX-Institute/potat1.pth](https://huggingface.co/DREX-Institute/potat1.pth)

But I can not generate as "No such file or directory: '/content/stable-diffusion-webui/models/ModelScope/t2v/configuration.json'".  
Thanks!

replies.author: ptitrainvaloin
replies.body: I don't use colab but you can find the missing files you need on https://huggingface.co/damo-vilab/modelscope-damo-text-to-video-synthesis/tree/main copy to stable-diffusion-webui/models/ModelScope/t2v/. or wherever it is installed. Make sure you downloaded the file named ‘configuration.json’ in its raw text form (click on the ⬇️ character to the right, don’t save via right-click). You can also find newer versions on huggingface based on modelscope and overwrite some of the files by newer ones and it will probably still work, goodluck!
